# Proper Pages

> Hand-coded websites you own outright. Fixed prices, no agency, live in weeks not months.

## Services

- [The Brochure Build](https://properpages.co.uk/#brochure-build): From £1,400, typically one week. One page that turns visitors into enquiries, for tradespeople, coaches, therapists, consultants, and venues. Copy written, legal pages included. Bolt-ons: Calendly, Mailchimp signup, Stripe payment link, Instagram feed.
- [The Authority Build](https://properpages.co.uk/#authority-build): From £2,800. One conversation, copy written for you, design, code, launch.
- [The Platform Escape](https://properpages.co.uk/#platform-escape): From £3,500. Everything above plus zero-downtime migration from Wix, WordPress, or Squarespace.
- [The Executive Teardown](https://properpages.co.uk/#executive-teardown): £500. Five-page diagnostic audit of your current site — where enquiries leak, how you appear in search and AI answers. Yours to keep; credited off the build if you hire.
- [The Brochure Care Plan](https://properpages.co.uk/#brochure-care): £50/month. Hosting, monitoring, changes within 48 hours, quarterly check that the live site matches what shipped, same-working-day answers. Cancel any time — you own the files outright.
- [The Authority Retainer](https://properpages.co.uk/#authority-retainer): £200/month. Hosting, monitoring, updates, quarterly GEO review.

## Proof

- [The Unrushed Mind case study](https://properpages.co.uk/case-study): From Wix to hand-coded in three working days. 24 KB, £0/month hosting, zero email downtime.
